scenicChapters.title: Shkoder → Leqet e Hotit
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 87 km. 684 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Albania SH20 Kelmend Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 684 m come off over 28 km at around 5.1%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Albania SH20 Kelmend Road
